plugins.prepareCmd: sed -i'' -e 's/Requires veld v[0-9][0-9.]*/Requires veld v${nextRelease.version}/' -e 's/version: "[0-9][0-9.]*"/version: "${nextRelease.version}"/' skills/veld/SKILL.md && sed -i'' -e "s/^version = \"[^\"]*\"/version = \"${nextRelease.version}\"/" Cargo.toml && cargo update -w && (cd desktop && npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version ${nextRelease.version})
